title: OSSC CGL Result 2026 Out @ossc.gov.in, Download Prelims Merit List PDF
fullContentHtml:
OSSC CGL Result 2026 has been released on 19th May 2026. The OSSC Combined Graduate Level Recruitment Examination prelims written exam was held on 19th April 2026. The exam was conducted to fill 1,576 vacancies for Group B and C posts. A total of 150 objective-type questions were asked in the exam, and it was held in a single shift. Questions from Arithmetic, Reasoning, Current Affairs, and Computer Awareness were asked. Candidates who appeared for the exam can check the OSSC CGL Result 2026 on the official website or via the direct link provided in the article. You can click on the direct link given in the article to check for any discrepancies.

OSSC Combined Graduate Level Result 2026

The OSSC CGL Result 2026 has been released for the candidates who appeared in the preliminary exam. The result is based on the marks obtained in the OMR-based exam held on 19 April 2026. Only shortlisted candidates have been selected for the next stage, which is the Main Written Examination. The roll numbers of selected candidates are available in the official list. However, this selection is only provisional and does not confirm final appointment. Candidates are advised to regularly check the OSSC website for the main exam schedule and updates.

OSSC CGL Result 2026 Download Link

The OSSC CGL Result 2026 download link has been activated on the OSSC’s official website. The result can be checked by visiting the “Results” section available on the official website. Log in through your credentials and download the OSSC CGL merit list PDF. The PDF consists of name, roll number, category, and qualifying status of the candidate. For your convenience, we have provided direct link to download OSSC CGL 2026 Result.

How To Download OSSC CGL Result 2026?

Candidates who appeared in the prelims exam held on 18th April 2026 can download the OSSC Combined Graduate Level Result from ossc.gov.in. Mentioned below are the steps to download the OSSC CGL Result 2026.

Step 1: Click on the direct link mentioned above or visit the official website of OSSC.

Step 2: Search for “New Notices” tab on the website and look for the result link.

Step 3: Click on the OSSC CGL Result link and download the PDF.

Step 4: CTRL+ F your roll number.

Step 4: Alternatively, you can also log in with your Registered Username / Registration Number and download your scorecard.

Details mentioned on the OSSC CGL Result 2026

After downloading the result, you must make sure to check the details mentioned on the OSSC CGL Result 2026. Some major details to be verified are mentioned below.

  1. Candidate’s name
  2. Roll Number
  3. Category
  4. Category Rank

What after OSSC Combined Graduate Level Results 2026?

After you have checked the OSSC CGL prelims Result, its important that you also know the further stages of selection. Post clearing the prelims exam, candidates will have to appear for the mains written exam. An admit card for the selected students will be updated on the official portal. You are advised to keep checking the official website for further updates.

How to Check OSSC CGL Marks?

OSSC CGL marks can be checked by the candidates from the result PDF available on the official website. Having an idea of the OSSC CGL marks gives you an understanding of your performance in the exam, along with knowing the chances of qualifying for further stages of selection.

Step 1: Visit the OSSC official website.

Step 2: Click the “New Notices” section there you will find the result link.

Step 3: Click on the “OSSC CGL Result” link using your Registration number and password.

Step 4: CTRL+F your roll number and look for your marks under the respective highlighted option.

Step 5: Download and save it for further use.

How to Calculate OSSC CGL Marks?

To calculate the OSSC CGL Marks, candidates must have the OSSC CGL Answer Key. The answer key is an official document released by the exam conducting authorities that provides the correct answers of the questions asked in the exam. It is an important document that helps you in self-assessment.

Step 1: Visit the official website and download the OSSC CGL Answer Key.

Step 2: Check the answers that you have marked in the exam to the answers specified in the answer key. Match the responses.

Step 3: Calculate the total number of corrects answers and the totla number of wrong answers.

Step 4: Calculate marks using the marking scheme specified in the official notification.

Step 5: For every correct answer give +1 marks and for every incorrect answer deduct 0.25 marks

Step 6: Calculate using the formula, Final Score = (Total correct answers *1)- (Incorrect answers *0.25)

Step 7: The score you get is your calculated marks.
